author: Carlos Martinez
title: Toyota Grand Prix of Long Beach 2018: My Fan Footage
description: My own clips from the 2018 Toyota Grand Prix of Long Beach: IndyCars, Stadium Super Trucks and the Mothers Exotic Car Paddock.

sections.p: This is my footage from the 2018 Toyota Grand Prix of Long Beach in California, USA. I filmed the race on April 15, 2018. It runs on an 11-turn, 1.968-mile (3.17 km) street course by the harbor.
I filmed all of it myself, from the grandstand and from the fence. No stock video and no TV feed, just what I saw and recorded.
Alexander Rossi won the IndyCar race from pole in the blue and yellow NAPA car. He led 71 of the 85 laps.
The weekend was not only IndyCar. Stadium Super Trucks, the off-road truck series founded by Robby Gordon, ran on the same streets.
I watched from two spots. The grandstand gave me the front straight, and the fence put me close to the cars as they went past. Both angles are in the clips.

list: The front straight, filmed from the stands.
Cars seen through the fence, close up.
Stadium Super Trucks on the street course.
A walk around the Mothers Exotic Car Paddock, with a Pagani Huayra BC, a Batman-style Lamborghini, Porsche 911s and rows of supercars.
A selfie of me, taken mid-race.

sections.p: The Pagani Huayra BC is my most viewed clip from this weekend.
